title: 第12章 内室火拼
content_zh:
曹虎虽微存戒心，但想以岳胜这等英雄，尚且败在自己手里，若温宏伟复生，或许惧他几分，温老太本领再高也属有限，鬼头刀虚劈一招，笑着说：“你要比试刀法，何不就在大厅？巴巴到这儿来，难道定要丈夫的死人牌位在一旁瞧着，才显得出本事么？”温老太凛然说：“不错！先夫威灵，震慑鼠辈。”曹虎不自禁向那灵牌望了一眼，心中有些发毛，急欲了结此事，走出这间冷冰冰、黑沉沉的灵堂，说道：“老太太，你发招吧。”温老太说：“你是客人，曹寨主先请。”她听他改了称呼，口头上也就客气了些，于是称他一声“寨主”。

    曹虎说：“在下跟温家堡无冤无仇，劫货只冲着岳老头而来。老太太定要出头，咱们点到为止，不必真砍真杀。”温老太双眉竖起，低沉着嗓子说：“没那么容易！先夫一生英雄，他建下的温家堡岂容外人说进便进，说出便出？”曹虎也自恼了，问道：“依你说便怎样？”温老太说：“你败了我手中紫金刀，将我人头割去，连我儿子也一并杀了……”曹虎一惊，心想：“我跟你又无深冤大仇，只不过无意冒犯，何必性命相拼？”只听她又说：“若是我胜得一招半式，曹寨主颈上脑袋可也得留下。”此言一出，跟着喝道：“进招！”

    曹虎气往上冲，大声说：“我不要你母子性命，只要你这座温家堡。”钢刀轻晃，欲待进招，温老太一招“朝阳刀”已狠劈过来，又快又猛，曹虎急忙侧头，呼的一响，震得右耳中嗡嗡作声，那刀从右腮边直削下去，相距寸余，只要闪避慢得一刻，这脑袋便给她劈成两半。

    这一刀先声夺人，曹虎给她的猛砍恶杀吓得一怔，知她第二招定要回刀削腰，忙沉鬼头刀竖架，当的一响，双刀相交，火光四溅。曹虎觉她膂力平平，远逊于己，本已提起的心又放了下来，一招“推刀割喉”推了过去。温老太哼了一声，侧身避过，说道：“四门刀法，不足为奇。”曹虎笑着说：“平平无奇，却要胜你。”语声未毕，踏步上前，使出一招“进手连环刀”。温老太不架不让，竟抢对攻，“削耳撩腮”，举刀斜砍。

    曹虎大惊，暗想：“怎么拼命了？”本来武术中有不救自身、反击敌人的招数，但这种拼着两败俱伤的打法，总带着几分凶险，非至敌招难解、万不得已之际决计不用。此时温老太只消举刀一挡，便能架开敌招，哪知她竟行险招，不顾性命地对攻。

    她不顾性命，曹虎却不得不顾，危急中扑地滚倒，反身一腿。这腿去势奇妙，温老太手腕险遭踢中，紫金刀急忙翻转，曹虎才收腿转身。曹虎的刀法原只平平，但因特别机缘，学到了十余招怪异拳脚，夹入刀法中，一路第三四流的四门刀法顿时化腐朽为神奇，近年来居然也打败了不少英雄好汉，混到个盗寨之主，此刻施展出来，每当刀法上走了下风，拳脚一动，立时扳转劣势。

    顷刻间一个老妇、一个盗魁，双刀疾舞，在砖房中斗得尘土飞扬。曹虎见温老太刀法精妙，自己若非靠那十余招拳脚救驾保命，早已丧生于紫金刀下，一个老妪居然有此武功，不禁暗暗称奇，心想：“如此久战下去，如一个疏忽，给她削去半边脑袋，那可不是玩的。”当下用长藏拙，不住地拳打足踢，偶尔才砍上几刀。这法儿果然生效，温老太难以抵挡，不断退避。曹虎洋洋得意，笑着说：“嘿嘿，温宏伟算什么东西，八卦刀法也不过如此。”

    温老太对先夫敬若天神，此言犯了她的大忌，突然目露凶光，刀法忽变，四下游走，白光闪闪，四面八方攻了上去。此刻她每招都是抢攻，每招都是拼命，将自己生死置之度外。曹虎大叫：“你疯了么？你丈夫可不是我杀的，你跟我拼命干嘛？喂，你听见我说话没有？”口中大叫大嚷，低头避刀，脚下狂奔逃蹿。

    他斗志一失，温老太更砍杀得如疯似狂，出刀越来越快，此时曹虎的怪异拳脚已来不及使用，只想劈开铁锁，逃出屋去。面对一只疯了的母大虫，他哪里还想到什么胜负荣辱，唯一的念头只是如何逃命。

    他数次要去劈开铁锁，总是给温老太逼得绝无余暇。眼见她“夜叉探海”、“上步撩刀”、“仙人指路”，一刀猛似一刀，曹虎把心一横，反背一腿踢出，叫声：“失陪！”左足用劲，蹿身从窗口跃了出去。岂知温老太拼着受他这腿，跟着挥刀砍去，同时左手使出一招荣光之爪。只听二人同声啊哟，一起跌在窗下。

    温老太立即跃起，肩头虽给踢中，未受重伤。曹虎的大腿上却给结结实实地一刀砍着，再也站立不起。危急时刻，把头一侧，避开了温老太那一抓，但是肩头却给撕扯下一大块皮肉。这下他吓得魂飞天外，见温老太眼布红丝，自己头顶白光闪动，紫金刀跟着劈落，忙伸双手抱住她小腿，大叫：“饶命！”

    温老太一怔，她是武师之女，幼时陪伴父亲、婚后跟随丈夫闯荡江湖，毕生会过无数武林豪杰，如眼前这般没出息的混蛋，却从未见过，心下鄙视，这刀就砍不下去。曹虎索性爬在地下，咚咚咚大磕响头，哀求说：“大人不记小人过！我是狗贼日的杂种、狗娘养的混蛋！老太太要抽筋剥皮，悉从尊便。这刀务请留一留手！”

    温老太叹了口气说：“好，命便饶你。你记住了，今日比武之事，不许漏出一字。”曹虎求之不得，连声答应。温老太喝道：“滚吧！”曹虎赔个笑脸，又磕了两个头，爬了起来，用刀拄在地下，一瘸一拐走出。温老太厉声说：“站住！咱们拼刀之前，说过任谁输了，就得在温家堡留下脑袋。你说话不算数，难道我也跟你一般的混账？”

    曹虎吓了一跳，回过头来，见温老太脸上犹似罩着一层严霜，显是并非说笑，他腿上剧痛，难再动手，哀求说：“你……你不是饶了我么？”温老太说：“饶得你性命，饶不得你脑袋。”说着手中紫金刀一扬，厉声说：“温家紫金刀出手，素不空回！过来！”曹虎咕咚一声，双膝落地。温老太手法好快，左手提起他脑后头发，右手紫金刀反过来，刀背在他头颈中一碰，翻转刃锋一挥，已将他头发割断，喝道：“以发代首，留在温家堡。从今而后削发为僧，不得再在黑道中厮混！”曹虎喏喏连声。

    温老太说：“你裹好腿伤，戴上帽子，再到厅上招呼你手下，一伙王八蛋夹了尾巴滚出温家堡！”

    大厅上众人面面相觑，不知二人在内堂说些什么，等了良久，才见温老太出来。曹虎慢吞吞跟在后面，叫道：“兄弟们，货物不要了，大伙扯呼去。”

    此言一出，众人无不大为惊愕。张彪说：“大哥……”曹虎说：“回寨说话。”将手一挥，走出厅去。他不敢露出腿上受伤痕迹，强行支撑，咬紧牙关出去。众盗不敢违拗，向着一箱箱已经到手的货物狠狠望了几眼，转身退出。片刻之间，群盗退得干干净净。

    饶是岳胜见多识广，却也猜不透其中奥妙，见曹虎行过之处，地下点点滴滴留下一行血迹，料想他在内堂受了伤，看来温家堡内暗伏能人，却哪里料得着眼前这位老态龙钟的老妪适才竟跟他拼了一场生死决战。岳胜扶着女儿肩头站起待要施谢，温老太说：“文新，跟我进来！”岳胜一愕，只见他母子二人径自进了内堂。

    这下海安众人与三警员都纷纷议论，有的说温老太旧时必与那盗魁相识，曾有恩于他；有的说温老太一顿劝喻，动以利害，那盗魁想到与警官为敌，非同小可，终于悬崖勒马。正自瞎猜，温文新走了出来说：“家母请岳老板内堂奉茶。”

    内堂叙话，温老太劝岳胜留在温家堡养伤，一边派人到附近邀物流同行相助，转保货物前往井灵。经此一役，岳胜雄心全消，百胜拳的名号响了数十年，到头来却折在一个市井流氓般的盗匪手中，对走江湖的心顿时淡了。虽知温家堡是险地，不能多耽，但温老太护货不失，恩情太重，她的意思不敢不遵，同时他心底还存了个念头，极想一见那位挫败曹虎的武林高手。便郑重谢了温老太的好意，一口答应照办。

    温老太记得丈夫所以为闵恩仇所杀，岳胜也不免要担些干系，留他在温家堡暂住，本意要趁机杀了岳胜为丈夫报仇。但见他千恩万谢，隆重拜谢护货之德，眼见这岳老板猥猥琐琐，竟没半分英风豪气，而且他身受重伤，此刻若要伤他，可说已不费吹灰之力，想先夫一世豪杰，决不肯打这可怜的落水狗，手刃这等无力还手之辈。且留他住一时，看他如何行止，再定发落。
content_en:
Although Cao Hu was slightly wary, he wanted to defeat a hero like Yue Sheng, but he still lost at his own hands. If Wen Hongwei came back to life, he might be a little afraid of him. No matter how high Mrs. Wen's skills were, there were limits. She made a false move with the Ghost Head Sword and said with a smile: "You want to test the sword skills, why not just in the hall? When Baba comes here, does it have to be the memorial tablet of her husband's death to look at to show her ability?" Mrs. Wen said sternly."That's right! My husband has a powerful spirit, which scares the rats." Cao Hu couldn't help but glance at the spirit tablet, feeling a little scared in his heart. He was eager to end the matter, walked out of the cold and dark mourning hall, and said, "Old lady, you can make a move." Old Mrs. Wen said, "You are a guest. The leader of the Cao village invites you first." After hearing his change of title, she became more polite verbally, so she called him "the leader of the village."
Cao Hu said: "I have no grievances with Wenjiabao. The robberies are only aimed at Old Man Yue. The old lady must come forward, and we will stop it. There is no need to kill her." Old Mrs. Wen raised her eyebrows and said in a low voice: "It's not that easy! My husband has been a hero all his life. How can the Wenjiabao he built allow outsiders to come in and leave at their own word?" Cao Hu was also annoyed and asked: "Whatever you say.?" Mrs. Wen said: "You defeated me with the purple sword and cut off my head, and also killed my son..." Cao Hu was shocked and thought: "I don't have any deep grudges with you, but I didn't mean to offend you, so why would I fight with my life?" She then said, "If I win even one move, the head of the leader of Cao Village will be left behind." After saying this, he shouted: "Go ahead!"
Cao Hu was furious and said loudly: "I don't want the lives of your mother and son, I only want your Wen family fort." The steel knife was swaying slightly, and when she was about to strike, Mrs. Wen struck hard with the "Chaoyang Knife", fast and fierce. Cao Hu turned his head hurriedly, and with a cry, there was a buzzing in his right ear.
Cao Hu was stunned by her fierce slashing attack. He knew that she would cut her waist with the sword in the second move, so he hurriedly raised the ghost-headed sword. There was a clang, the two swords intersected, and fire flew everywhere.Cao Hu felt that her physical strength was mediocre and far inferior to his own. He was relieved and pushed her over with a "push knife and cut her throat" move.Mrs. Wen snorted, sidestepped and said, "It's not surprising that the four sword skills are there." Cao Hu said with a smile, "It's just ordinary, but I'm going to beat you." Before he finished speaking, he stepped forward and used the "Serial Sword" move.Old Mrs. Wen refused to give in, and actually attacked each other, "cutting her ears and lifting her cheeks", and raised her knife to slash at an angle.
Cao Hu was shocked and thought to himself: "Why are you so desperate?" Originally, there were moves in martial arts to counterattack the enemy without saving oneself, but this style of fighting, in which both sides were harmed, was always somewhat dangerous and should not be used unless the enemy was difficult to defeat and it was a last resort.At this time, Mrs. Wen only had to raise her sword to block the enemy's attack, but she unexpectedly made a dangerous move and fought without regard for her life.
She didn't care about her life, but Cao Hu had to care. In the critical moment, he rolled to the ground and turned around.The castration of this leg was wonderful. Mrs. Wen was almost kicked in the wrist. The Zijin knife quickly turned over, and Cao Hu retracted his leg and turned around.Cao Hu's sword skills were mediocre at first, but due to a special opportunity, he learned more than ten strange fists and kicks, and when he incorporated them into his sword skills, the four sword skills that were third to fourth rate all the way suddenly turned into magic. In recent years, he has actually defeated many heroes and became the leader of a bandit village. Now that he is showing off, whenever his sword skills are at a disadvantage, a move of his fists and kicks will immediately turn his disadvantage around.
In an instant, an old woman and a bandit leader were fighting with two swords in the brick house until the dust flew up.Cao Hu saw that Mrs. Wen's sword skills were exquisite. If he hadn't saved his life with the more than ten punches and kicks, he would have been killed by the purple gold sword. An old woman could actually have such martial arts. He couldn't help but secretly marveled. He thought: "If we fight for such a long time and cut off half of her head due to negligence, it's not fun."This method really worked. Mrs. Wen couldn't resist and kept retreating.Cao Hu was very proud and said with a smile: "Hey, Wen Hongwei is nothing, Bagua sword skills are nothing more than that."
Old Mrs. Wen respected her late husband as if he were a god. This remark violated her taboo. She suddenly showed a fierce look in her eyes, and her sword skills suddenly changed. She moved around, flashing white light, and attacked from all directions.At this moment, every move she made was an attack, every move was a desperate move, regardless of her own life or death.Cao Hu shouted: "Are you crazy? I didn't kill your husband. Why are you fighting so hard for me? Hey, did you hear me?" He was shouting, lowering his head to avoid the knife, and running away with his feet.
As soon as he lost his fighting spirit, Mrs. Wen started slashing like crazy, drawing the knife faster and faster. At this time, Cao Hu had no time to use his weird fists and kicks, and just wanted to split the iron lock and escape from the house.Facing a crazy female insect, he couldn't think of victory, defeat, honor or disgrace. His only thought was how to escape.
He tried to split the iron locks several times, but Mrs. Wen always forced her to do so without any time left.Seeing her "yaksha exploring the sea", "stepping up to lift the knife", and "immortal pointing the way", with a knife as sharp as a knife, Cao Hu felt his heart cross and kicked out with his back, shouting: "Excuse me!" He used his left foot hard and jumped out of the window.Unexpectedly, Mrs. Wen struggled to hold his leg, then slashed it with her knife, and at the same time used her left hand to use the Claw of Glory.I heard the two of them yelling at the same time, and they fell under the window together.
Mrs. Wen immediately jumped up. Although she was kicked on the shoulder, she was not seriously injured.However, Cao Hu was stabbed hard on the thigh and could no longer stand.At the critical moment, he turned his head to one side to avoid Old Mrs. Wen's grasp, but a large piece of flesh was torn off his shoulder.At this moment, he was so frightened that he saw Mrs. Wen's eyes were covered with red threads, white light flashed above his head, and the purple gold knife followed. He quickly stretched out his hands to hug her calves and shouted: "Spare my life!"
Old Mrs. Wen was startled. She was the daughter of a martial artist. She accompanied her father when she was young, and followed her husband in the world after marriage. She had met countless martial arts heroes in her life, but she had never seen such a worthless bastard before her. She despised him in her heart, and the knife could not cut it.Cao Hu simply crawled on the ground, kowtowed his head loudly, and begged: "Adults don't remember the faults of villains! I am a bastard, a bastard of a bitch! The old lady wants to have cramps and skinning, so please do as you please. Please keep this knife handy!"
Mrs. Wen sighed and said, "Okay, I'll spare your life. Remember, don't let out a word about today's martial arts competition." Cao Hu couldn't get what he asked for, so he agreed repeatedly.Old Mrs. Wen shouted: "Go away!" Cao Hu smiled, kowtowed twice more, got up, put his knife on the ground, and limped out.Old Mrs. Wen said sternly: "Stop! Before we fought, we said that whoever loses will have his head left in Wenjiapu. If you don't keep your word, am I a bastard like you?"
Cao Hu was startled. He turned around and saw that Mrs. Wen's face seemed to be covered with a layer of frost. It was obvious that she was not joking. His leg was in severe pain and it was difficult to do anything. He begged: "You...don't you spare me?" Mrs. Wen said, "I'll spare your life, but I won't spare your head." He raised the purple gold knife in his hand and said sternly: "The Wen family's purple gold knife strikes, and I don't have time to come back! Come here!" Cao Hu made a thud and landed on his knees.Mrs. Wen's technique was very fast. She lifted the hair on the back of his head with her left hand, reversed the purple gold knife in her right hand, touched his head and neck with the back of the knife, flipped the blade and swung it, cutting off his hair. She shouted: "I will take my hair as my head and stay in Wenjiabao. From now on, I will cut off my hair and become a monk, and I will no longer hang out in the underworld!" Cao Hu said repeatedly.
Old Mrs. Wen said: "Wrap your leg injury, put on your hat, and go to the hall to greet your men. A bunch of bastards will get out of Wenjiapu with their tails between their legs!"
Everyone in the hall looked at each other, wondering what the two of them were talking about in the hall. They waited for a long time before seeing Mrs. Wen come out.Cao Hu slowly followed behind and shouted: "Brothers, I don't want the goods anymore, let's go grab them."
As soon as this statement came out, everyone was shocked.Zhang Biao said: "Brother..." Cao Hu said: "Go back to the stronghold to talk." He waved his hand and walked out of the hall.He didn't dare to show the traces of injuries on his legs, so he forced himself to hold on and gritted his teeth to get out.The thieves did not dare to disobey, they looked hard at the boxes of goods they had received, then turned around and exited.In a moment, the thieves retreated completely.
Even though Yue Sheng was well-informed, he couldn't figure out the mystery. Wherever Cao Hu walked, there were traces of blood on the ground. He expected that he was injured in the inner hall. It seemed that there was a capable person hidden in the Wenjia Fort, but he never expected that the decrepit old woman in front of him had just fought a life-and-death battle with him.Yue Sheng stood up holding his daughter's shoulders and was about to thank her. Mrs. Wen said, "Wen Xin, come in with me!" Yue Sheng was stunned and saw his mother and son walking into the inner hall.
At this time, everyone in Hai'an and the three police officers were all talking. Some said that Old Mrs. Wen must have known the bandit leader in the old days and had been kind to him; some said that Old Mrs. Wen persuaded her and used her interests to make the bandit leader think of being an enemy of the police officer.Just as he was making wild guesses, Wen Wenxin came out and said, "My mother invites Boss Yue to serve tea in the inner hall."
During the conversation in the inner hall, Mrs. Wen advised Yue Sheng to stay in Wenjiabao to recuperate. At the same time, she sent people nearby to invite logistics colleagues to help, and transferred the goods to Jingling.After this battle, Yue Sheng's ambitions were all gone. The name of Yum Sheng Quan had been famous for decades, but in the end it was lost in the hands of a gangster who was like a gangster in the market. His desire to travel around the world suddenly faded away.Although he knew that Wenjiabao was a dangerous place and could not delay any longer, Mrs. Wen was still protecting the goods and her kindness was so great that he did not dare to disobey her. At the same time, he still had the idea in his heart that he wanted to meet the martial arts master who defeated Cao Hu.He solemnly thanked Mrs. Wen for her kindness and agreed to do it.
Mrs. Wen remembered that her husband was killed by Min Enchou, and Yue Sheng could not help but bear some responsibility, so she left him to stay temporarily in Wenjiabao, intending to take the opportunity to kill Yue Sheng to avenge her husband.But seeing him thank him so much for his kindness and solemnly thanking him for his virtues in protecting goods. Seeing that Boss Yue is wretched and insignificant, and he has no heroic spirit at all. Moreover, he is seriously injured. If you want to hurt him at this moment, it is easy to say. I want my husband to be a hero, and I will never beat this poor drowned dog. I will kill someone like this who is unable to fight back.Let him stay for a while, see how he behaves, and then decide where to go.
